name: app-oviah-onboarding-and-symptom-logging-screens-grid
title: OVIAH onboarding and daily logging: mode selection, calendar setup, symptom and lifestyle tracker screens
whatItIs: A tilted grid of 15 phone screens: mode selection (First Period vs Regular), a feature preview grid, a calendar for last-period date, notification preferences, a setup-complete screen, the home dashboard, an insights summary, a symptom logger (flow, mood, symptoms), and lifestyle/medication tracking forms with icon toggles.
whatItMeans: Personalised and thorough; branching onboarding by period stage shows the app adapts to very different users.
techniques: Branch onboarding early based on a key user difference.
Preview what each mode unlocks before committing.
Use icon toggle grids for fast symptom logging.

vocabulary.definition: Onboarding that adapts based on an early user choice.
A selectable button combining an icon and label.
